t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The game follows a pattern whereby for example, the yellow gnome will show you 4 points, then 2 points, then 0 points and then the pattern repeats again. If you identify the pattern in the first round, you can make lots in the second and third round.

vb_textbox.text: The number of mushrooms each gnome gives you decreases each time you see it e.g., if the yellow gnome gives you 4, next time it will be 2, and eventually 0. Once it gets to 0, it will eventually repeat. Try and work out the pattern in the first couple of rounds to increase your score in the later ones.
